description: Figure 1, titled "Distribution of Content Types in the DODa," is a donut chart that illustrates the composition of the dataset. The chart is divided into six distinct segments, each representing a different content type, with a legend on the right providing the color and label for each category. The largest segment, colored light green, represents "Pending Translations" with 43,000 entries. The second largest, a golden-yellow segment, corresponds to "Translated Sentences," which contains 45,387 entries. The third largest segment, a dark blue, represents "Extra + Augmented Data" with 30,000 entries. The "Syntactic Roles" category, shown in orange, accounts for 23,108 entries. The "Semantic Categories" segment, in purple, is the smallest visible slice. The "Moroccan Names" category, in red, is also present but is not labeled with a numerical value in the chart itself. The chart visually emphasizes the relative proportions of these content types within the dataset.
